Children & Education

Upcoming program

Opportunity should never depend on what a child can afford.

Learning and practical skills can open new possibilities. Aashray for Children & Education aims to help children and young people access opportunities that support their education and future.

01 / Children & Education

Upcoming computer training

We are preparing to introduce a computer training program for students. The initiative will focus on practical digital skills and learning opportunities.

The program has not yet launched. Dates, location, eligibility, course content and the registration process will be announced when confirmed.

Express Interest in Computer Training

02 / Children & Education

The direction we want to develop

Digital literacy, educational support, learning resources and skill development are areas we intend to explore as this pillar grows. These are planned areas of work, alongside the upcoming computer training initiative.

03 / Children & Education

Ways to contribute

Educators, trainers and organisations can discuss how they may help with learning resources, instruction or program support. Share your expertise or interest with our team so we can explore a practical contribution.
